runtime/foundation/verification/orchestr.role: Main verification orchestrator (Program 7B) - collects changed files, runs cross-layer impact, generates plan, executes, aggregates evidence
runtime/foundation/verification/orchestr.notes: Primary orchestrator for all verification runs. Handles changed-file detection, plan generation, execution, and report generation.

runtime/foundation/verification/planner/.role: Verification planner - generates verification plans from changed files/capabilities/endpoints
runtime/foundation/verification/planner/.notes: Contains both VerificationPlanner and CrossLayerImpactPlanner (Program 7A). Handles scope merging, bounded profile semantics, and dependency resolution.

runtime/foundation/verification/registry.role: Verification registry - loads verification.yaml, registers workflows/scripts/capabilities
runtime/foundation/verification/registry.notes: Contains UNIT_TO_WORKFLOW mapping (VEA-2 Phase 2 M2) and default workflows/scripts/capabilities. Single source of truth for registry data.

runtime/foundation/verification/capabili.role: Canonical capability catalog (M9-C51) - frozen inventory of all verification capabilities
runtime/foundation/verification/capabili.notes: Contains VerificationCapabilityMetadata dataclass, CapabilityStage enum, CostClass enum, AuthorizationLevel enum, and EVIDENCE_KINDS closed vocabulary.
Builds graph from capability catalog. Contains canonical pipeline spine edges and evidence dependency edges.
Resolves changed files to capabilities, determines directly/transitively affected capabilities, evidence reuse decisions.

runtime/foundation/verification/capabili.role: Capability contract registry - per-capability metadata including affected_by_paths, workflow_mappings, test_mappings
runtime/foundation/verification/capabili.notes: Provides structured capability definitions with workflow and test mappings.
Discovers capabilities from the repository structure.

runtime/foundation/verification/blast_ra.role: Canonical blast-radius contract (M9-C50) - answers 15 questions about change impact
runtime/foundation/verification/blast_ra.notes: Comprehensive blast-radius contract with SurfaceImpact, CapabilityImpact, VerificationSurfaceRequirement, EvidenceInvalidation, EscalationCondition dataclasses.

runtime/foundation/verification/mutation.role: Canonical mutation result contract (M9-C42.5) - single source of truth for mutation result schema, three-gate classification
runtime/foundation/verification/mutation.notes: Contains ENGINE_SELECTION dict with 14 components (credit_card, account, balance, ledger_audit, reconciliation, loan, behaviour, cashflow, financial_events, core_domain_money, common_calculations, recommendation, transaction_intelligence, financial_intelligence). Three-gate classification (A=Execution, B=Evidence, C=Quality). MutationResult dataclass with provenance.

runtime/foundation/verification/mutation.role: Canonical mutation runner (M9-C42.5) - replaces bash pipeline with deterministic Python runner
runtime/foundation/verification/mutation.notes: Invoked via 'python runtime/verify.py mutation'. Handles smoke/target/full modes. Writes mutation-summary.json and measurement-truth.json. Uses _MutationSafety context manager for config restoration.

runtime/foundation/verification/mutation.role: Mutation campaign orchestrator (M9-C44) - coordinates baseline gate, candidate discovery, execution, cache, retries
runtime/foundation/verification/mutation.notes: Owns mutation execution semantics. Calls ONLY MutationBackendBase interface. Never invokes mutmut directly. Has parallel and serial execution modes. NOTE: The verify.py mutation path uses mutation_runner.py, NOT this orchestrator.

runtime/foundation/verification/mutation.role: Canonical mutation domain model (M9-C44.1) - repository-owned data types independent of mutmut
runtime/foundation/verification/mutation.notes: Schema: m9-c44-mutation-domain/v1. Contains canonical result states (KILLED, SURVIVED, EQUIVALENT, NO_TESTS, TIMEOUT, EXECUTION_ERROR, INVALID_MUTANT, NOT_EXECUTED, CANCELLED, UNKNOWN).
The ONLY mutmut integration point. Never invoke mutmut directly elsewhere.

runtime/foundation/verification/mutation.role: Mutation cache for caching per-mutant results
runtime/foundation/verification/mutation.notes: Separate from the verification cache.py. Caches per-mutant results keyed by configuration fingerprint.

runtime/foundation/verification/mutation.role: Mutation workspace management (M44.6) - create/resume/persist campaign workspace
runtime/foundation/verification/mutation.notes: Workspace persistence for campaign resume capability.

runtime/foundation/verification/mutation.role: Mutation result verification (M44.15) - was mutated source actually active?
runtime/foundation/verification/mutation.notes: Verifies that the mutation was actually applied before classifying.
Final certification step for mutation results.
Computes deterministic fingerprints for source/config invalidation.

runtime/foundation/verification/mutation.role: Abstract backend interface for mutation tools
runtime/foundation/verification/mutation.notes: Abstract interface for mutation backends. MutmutAdapter implements this.

runtime/foundation/verification/cache.py.notes: Content-aware invalidation (R-CACHE-1). Cache key includes (commit, changed_files, profile, fingerprint, tree_digest). Exit code derived from stored status, never 0 when stored status is 'fail'.

runtime/foundation/verification/executor.role: Verification step executor - runs subprocess commands with timeouts and logging
runtime/foundation/verification/executor.notes: Executes verification commands as subprocesses with per-step timeout and log callback.
Pipeline for evidence-based execution: plan -> execute -> reconcile -> certify.

runtime/foundation/verification/evidence.role: VEA-5 M6 evidence contract - per-unit execution evidence with attempts and artifacts
runtime/foundation/verification/evidence.notes: Schema: vea5-execution-evidence/v2. Hard invariant: unit_id -> attempt -> artifact. Also contains DEEP_VERIFICATION_SURFACES (13 surfaces across functional/regression/test-effectiveness/UI/performance/security domains).

runtime/foundation/verification/evidence.role: M9-C42.27 evidence reuse, population snapshots, measurement invalidation rules
runtime/foundation/verification/evidence.notes: Contains 13 invalidation rules (R-SRC-001 through R-TASK-001). Contains C42_26_COMPONENTS (14 components). Contains ENGINE_TO_CAPABILITY mapping (14 entries).

runtime/system/evidence/aggregator.py.role: Evidence aggregator - combines test/coverage/mutation/contract/property evidence into summary
runtime/system/evidence/aggregator.py.notes: Contains VEA-2 Phase 2 M5 frontend representation (E-2 fix) and unit-keyed failure joining (E-3 fix). VEA-3 M2 replaces E-4 keyword guessing with unit-keyed graph traversal. Contains OBSOLETE functions (_find_chain_for_failure, _find_dependency_chain) marked as E-4 defect.

runtime/system/evidence/collectors/test_.notes: Collects test results from JUnit XML files.

runtime/system/evidence/collectors/cover.notes: Collects coverage data from coverage.py JSON output.

runtime/system/evidence/collectors/mutat.notes: Collects mutation results from mutmut output text.

runtime/foundation/verification/api_cont.role: M9-C27 API Contract Integrity & Drift-Proofing gate
runtime/foundation/verification/api_cont.notes: Runs STRUCTURAL freshness, GENERATED-type reproducibility, CONSUMER integrity, and WIRE validation.
Forensic certification for API contract governance.
Test fixtures for API contract testing.

runtime/foundation/verification/cli/cli..role: Verification Runtime CLI (Phase 6) - plan, scope, capability, resolve, explain, registry, validate
runtime/foundation/verification/cli/cli..notes: Planning-only CLI. Does NOT execute tests. Contains plan/scope/capability/resolve/explain/registry/validate commands. Also has 'backend' and 'evidence' subcommands for selective verification and evidence download.

runtime/verify.py.role: Autonomous Verification Runtime CLI entry point (Program 7B)
runtime/verify.py.notes: The CANONICAL CLI entry point. 100+ commands including: quick, backend, frontend, contracts, mutation, audit, certify, api-contracts, contract-governance, plan, reconcile, exec-evidence, etc. Dispatches to appropriate modules.

runtime/foundation/verification/profiles.notes: Defines verification profiles (quick, backend, frontend, contracts, etc.) with scopes and constraints.

runtime/foundation/verification/env.py.notes: Resolves mutmut/pytest/python binaries. Pins mutmut==3.7.0. Detects forbidden venvs (backend/venv, backend/.venv). Emits machine-readable environment fingerprint.

runtime/foundation/verification/measurem.notes: Defines MeasurementTruthRecord, EvidenceClassification, FailureClassification, MeasurementCompletionStatus, PopulationAccounting.
CLI for managing measurement truth records.

runtime/foundation/verification/measurem.role: Measurement truth integration with mutation runner

runtime/foundation/verification/coverage.role: Coverage measurement (line/branch coverage by architectural layer)
runtime/foundation/verification/coverage.notes: Measures coverage by layer (engines, services, repositories, etc.).

runtime/foundation/verification/survivor.role: Survivor intelligence - per-mutant surviving mutant analysis
runtime/foundation/verification/survivor.notes: Builds per-mutant survivor intelligence with covering tests, capability, fingerprint.

runtime/foundation/verification/survivor.role: Survivor catalog - structured per-function survivor breakdown
runtime/foundation/verification/survivor.notes: C43.7 structured per-function survivor breakdown via libcst reconstruction.

runtime/foundation/verification/generati.notes: Engine for automatic test generation from survivors.

runtime/foundation/verification/gap_clas.notes: Classifies test gaps (REAL_TEST_GAP, EQUIVALENT_MUTANT, NO_TEST_DISCOVERY, TIMEOUT, TOOL_FAILURE, UNSUPPORTED_TRANSFORMATION, AMBIGUOUS).

runtime/foundation/verification/tier.py.role: Verification tier system (VEA-5) - local/pr/deep tiers with unit catalog
runtime/foundation/verification/tier.py.notes: Defines UNIT_CATALOG with 8 units (unit-targeted, backend-unit, backend-integration, contracts-schemathesis, frontend-unit, frontend-typecheck-build, playwright-e2e, runtime-self-test, mutation-run, golden-regression). TierPlan, SelectedUnit, ExcludedUnit dataclasses.

runtime/foundation/verification/reconcil.role: Plan reconciliation & CI reconciliation gate (VEA-5 M4/M5)
runtime/foundation/verification/reconcil.notes: M5 exit contract: same-plan -> 0, expected-tier-difference -> 0, environment-divergence -> 1, planning-divergence -> 2.

runtime/foundation/verification/failure_.notes: Builds actionable failure reports with classification and diagnostic information.

runtime/foundation/verification/correlat.notes: Correlates test results with environmental factors.

runtime/foundation/verification/change_s.notes: Discovers change surfaces with SurfaceKind enum (PRODUCTION, TEST, CONFIG, WORKFLOW, RUNTIME_INFRASTRUCTURE, etc.).

runtime/foundation/verification/shared_i.notes: AST-based shared module dependency index for transitive capability expansion.

runtime/foundation/verification/control_.notes: Efficiency metrics for the control plane.

runtime/foundation/verification/route_au.notes: Manages route authority for API endpoints.

runtime/foundation/verification/generati.notes: Checks if test generation is eligible for a given context.

duplicate_authorities_identified.name: Mutation Orchestration
duplicate_authorities_identified.authority_b: runtime/foundation/verification/mutation_execution/orchestrator.py (MutationOrchestrator.run) - exists but NOT called by verify.py
duplicate_authorities_identified.risk: Two parallel mutation execution paths exist. The verify.py path uses mutation_runner.py directly. The MutationOrchestrator in mutation_execution/ is a more sophisticated orchestrator (M9-C44) with parallel execution, sharding, and campaign management, but is NOT wired into the verify.py path. The simpler mutation_runner.py path is what actually runs in CI.

duplicate_authorities_identified.name: Cache System
duplicate_authorities_identified.authority_a: runtime/foundation/verification/cache.py (VerificationCache) - content-aware cache for verification runs
duplicate_authorities_identified.risk: Two separate cache systems. The verification cache is for overall run results; the mutation cache is for per-mutant results. No overlap in scope, but increases complexity.

duplicate_authorities_identified.name: Mutation Result Classification
duplicate_authorities_identified.authority_b: runtime/foundation/verification/mutation_execution/domain_model.py (MutationResult, MutationResultState) - canonical domain model with state enum
duplicate_authorities_identified.risk: Two MutationResult dataclasses exist. The mutation_contract.py one is the runner-facing one (with killed/survived/timeout/suspicious/not_checked buckets). The domain_model.py one is the canonical domain model (with KILLED/SURVIVED/EQUIVALENT/NO_TESTS/TIMEOUT/EXECUTION_ERROR/INVALID_MUTANT/NOT_EXECUTED/CANCELLED/UNKNOWN states). The two use different vocabularies. The runner uses the contract one; the orchestrator uses the domain model one.

duplicate_authorities_identified.name: Capability Registry
duplicate_authorities_identified.risk: Two separate capability registries. The VerificationRegistry is for workflow/script/capability registration from YAML. The CapabilityContractRegistry is for per-capability metadata with path mappings. Both are used by the resolver and planner.

duplicate_authorities_identified.name: Evidence Aggregator Obsolete Code
duplicate_authorities_identified.risk: Dead code retained per VEA-3 §0.3. Both functions are marked OBSOLETE and not called by production paths. They are retained for forensic purposes but represent a risk if accidentally called.
